issues.observed: The first broad registry search exceeded its ten-second bound and returned no usable result.
issues.recovery: Use exact GHC, Vesper, Neris, closeout, and routing terms against the memory registry, then open only the one directly referenced rollout.
issues.recurrence_guard: Begin memory retrieval with bounded exact terms and never scan all rollout content before the registry identifies a target.

issues.observed: The first skill inventory pipeline contained an empty pipeline element and failed before reading a skill.
issues.recovery: Use a materialized file array and one scalar literal-path read per required skill and reference.
issues.recurrence_guard: Materialize foreach output before piping and validate the PowerShell expression before combining reads.

issues.observed: The first manifest-summary pipeline contained an empty pipeline element and produced no manifest evidence.
issues.recovery: Read the exact manifest path, parse one JSON object, and emit scalar counts separately.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep manifest parsing and display as separate bounded operations.

issues.observed: An initial Git revision probe ran from the Codex configuration directory and failed because it was not a repository.
issues.recovery: Anchor every Git probe with git -C or an explicit repository workdir.
issues.recurrence_guard: Resolve and display the intended repository root before the first Git command.

issues.observed: The additive D-first worktree command exceeded its outer bound after Git had already registered and populated the lane.
issues.recovery: Audit the exact path, .git indirection, registered branch, HEAD, process state, and cleanliness; continue in place only after all pass.
issues.recurrence_guard: After a mutating command timeout, inspect durable state before any retry and never create a duplicate worktree blindly.

issues.observed: A broad post-timeout audit combined Git state with recursive lock discovery and exceeded its bound.
issues.recovery: Split path, .git, HEAD, branch, process, lock, and status checks into bounded scalar probes.
issues.recurrence_guard: Never combine recursive filesystem inspection with Git worktree recovery under one timeout.

issues.observed: The first very short bounded read of the worktree .git indirection timed out without evidence.
issues.recovery: Repeat only the exact literal-path read with a longer bounded timeout and no unrelated operations.
issues.recurrence_guard: Treat startup latency separately from command failure and keep recovery probes scalar.

issues.observed: The first manifest comparison mapped only phase documents and falsely reported thirty-two missing script and test blobs.
issues.recovery: Build the Git tree map from the complete commit and compare only the paths declared by the manifest.
issues.recurrence_guard: Scope manifest comparison by declared entries, not by an assumed phase-directory prefix.

issues.observed: A combined status, head, directory listing, and multi-JSON parse exceeded its bound without useful output.
issues.recovery: Run clean-state, revision, listing, and JSON reads as separate scalar probes.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep large-worktree Git traversal independent from JSON parsing and filesystem enumeration.

issues.observed: A recursive-grep command passed Windows wildcard paths directly and failed with an invalid filename error.
issues.recovery: Pass directories as roots and use rg -g include patterns for filenames.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use ripgrep glob filters rather than shell-style wildcard path operands on Windows.

issues.observed: The first radio-observatory concept overlapped inherited astronomy, LOFAR, HERA, EHT, MeerKAT, and planetarium proposal families and was abandoned before freeze.
issues.recovery: Select the seed-bank accession, storage, viability, distribution, and authority-boundary lens after whole-chain title screening showed no seed-bank or herbarium title collision.
issues.recurrence_guard: Screen candidate domains against the complete frozen title chain before drafting the phase catalogue.

issues.observed: The first x1 build compared the committed activation baton against a working-tree byte digest and stopped because Windows checkout line endings differed from the exact Git blob.
issues.recovery: Retain the failed build, compute the SHA-256 over git show binary output at the exact source commit, and use that immutable Git-blob digest.
issues.recurrence_guard: Declare the hash domain explicitly and use Git object bytes for committed-baton verification across Windows worktrees.

issues.observed: The first seed-image proposal title reached 0.6818 Jaccard similarity with the inherited remote-sensing transformation docket and the x1 build stopped before writing the packet.
issues.recovery: Retain the failed build and reframe the title around orthographic custody, ingredient digest, crop and annotation lineage, disclosure shielding, unsigned state, and origin nonclaim.
issues.recurrence_guard: Run the exact whole-chain novelty audit before any x1 artifact write and revise only colliding titles without weakening their falsifier or authority boundaries.
